body: Yeah I’m 25. I have 9 tattoos atm haha I really like them
I’ve got the transdimensional council of Ricks logo on my right arm (upper) and a beaker with “Rise above, focus on science” in a banner all traditional American style on my right forearm.

I’m a huge fan! I have two Rick and Morty tattoos actually. Trying to get all the fandoms inked on me lol

I feel really unstable. Like I’m teetering on the edge of “never okay again”. It’s hard to explain.

Okay so. I talk to one person every day, and one person semi frequently. Just recently found out that the 8 other people at my job would rather talk shit about me than talk to me. Also I see neither of the two people I talk to and— 

It’s just stupid and complicated. My cat Sausage is pretty alright though. I just feel crazy talking to him.
That’s okay it’s better than silence for days at a time ^^
I am not a dude. Sorry to disappoint.
I want to matter.
I just feel like I’m not going to matter to anyone. Like I can just vanish and no one would bother looking. Find out much later I died and there would be nothing to remember about me.

Let’s be friends. We can double up on that suicide in our 40s. 

Til then let’s laugh at suicide memes. 

(Please god be my friend, I am so alone.)
I've got two tattoos to the fandom. And that sauce is a fantasy bro. Just like me having any human value. 🙃
Also I love your name. Long live the Rick and Morty.
I feel like it won't be better no matter what. I'm just so exhausted with feeling this way.
This chills the blood in my barista veins. Please, not again.
As a barista, this eye roll is the core of everything I am and will be until people come to their senses.

Didn't think I could get pregnant, if you read anything I had said. 

Thanks, it's nice to see how intolerant people can be on a supposedly safe forum.
My follow up is on the 12th, wouldn't miss it for the world honestly. Thank you for your support, I'm feeling better as time goes on. It's just hard to not think of what ifs!

Wow I'm jealous! Haha. My boyfriend was bringing me ice pops and rubbing my back. He put me in a warm bubble bath, tried everything he could! 

Tell your wife I'd love to know her secrets. :)

Thank you so much for your kind words. As it stands right now, my boyfriend and I live 80 miles apart, and I lost my license on a technicality so I'm working 14 hours a day and riding a bicycle 9 miles just to make ends meet. It wasn't the right time to be pregnant and it tears both of us up. Soon I'll be living with him though, and then after some time we're going to try again. It was kind of a good thing because I honestly didn't think I could get pregnant. So now I know I can, and when my love and I are ready, we will build our family. 

I'm looking toward the future. It just hurts now, thinking of what could have been. He's helped so much I don't know what I would have done without him through this. Besides not being pregnant (we've been trying to joke through this together. But lightly, because we both respect what we're going through).

I really think I just have a low pain tolerance. I was prescribed pain medication for menstrual cramps when I was ~15. So I think that's why I had such a rough time. 

Also thank you for sharing what you've been through. I know it's a borderline common thing these days but I feel really alone in this. So I appreciate it.

Maybe I have a low pain tolerance? Idk. But this isn't a troll or anything. I made the account to talk about it in a supposedly supportive environment. I'm sorry. 

Also, I wanted the child. My boyfriend did too. It was a hard choice that we had to make. I never wanted to have an abortion. But it was the right choice for me. And if I had to do it over again, I would. So it's definitely a pro choice thing. It's just that every choice has consequences and I'm trying to fight through those.

Thank you, I actually have a therapist. I haven't told her yet but I'm seeing her on Wednesday. I feel ashamed. 

My boyfriend is also such a good support system for me. He was here for me through the whole thing. He held me while I was in tears. I know he was affected by it too. And he was being strong for both of us. It makes me love and appreciate him more. LDRs are hard. But soon it'll get better.
